# AC-UAT-01 — fresh reviewer verdict

Reviewer: fresh general-purpose subagent, given only `contact-sheet.jpg` (1 s sheet, 1280 px frames, 2 cols) and the case's still items.

1 PASS — Every beat has a caption: "Type a task and press Enter" at 01.00–04.00, "Tick a task when it is done" at 05.00–09.00, "Filters show what is left, or done" at 10.00–14.00, and "Clear done tasks to tidy up" at 15.00–19.00. 00.00 and 19.90 have no caption, but those are just the opening and closing frames.

2 PASS — A cursor sits on the control at each click: the input box at 01.00–05.00, the "Buy milk" checkbox at 06.00–09.00, the Active filter at 10.00–11.00, Done at 12.00–14.00, Clear done at 15.00–16.00, and All at 17.00–19.90.

3 PASS (one part UNSURE) — No blank or half-loaded frames, and the page is fully drawn from 00.00. Captions sit well below the card and never cover it. The data is only placeholder tasks ("Buy milk", "Call the plumber"), nothing private. The app state follows the clicks: 13.00–14.00 Done shows "Buy milk", 15.00–16.00 shows "Nothing here." after Clear done, 17.00 All shows only "Call the plumber". UNSURE on clipped text: the card's small text (footer buttons, "1 left") is too downscaled to check for clipping. Captions show no clipping.

**Overall: PASS.**
